title: The Potion of Six Strengths
story: Ironhide the Ogre is stomping toward the village, and no ordinary sword can dent his iron skin! Mr 6 must brew the legendary Potion of Six Strengths. The recipe calls for 6 red berries, 4 blue mushrooms, and 3 silver leaves from the Whispering Woods.
question: How many ingredients must Mr 6 gather in all?
hint: Add the three amounts together: 6 + 4 + 3. Try adding 6 + 4 first!
victory: The potion glows gold! Mr 6 drinks it down, lifts Ironhide over his head, and gently rolls him all the way back to his mountain. The village cheers!
solution: Add the first two amounts: 6 + 4 = 10 ingredients.
Mr 6 must gather 13 ingredients in all.
praise: Adding the amounts together was exactly the right plan - it looks like one of the three numbers got left out of the total. Add all three and you've got it!
